Rule list: the eight rules whose index row names ecto-phoenix: the six ecto-phoenix.md rules, Build a multi-line argument under a name before the call, and Open a module with `use`, `import`, `alias`, `require`, in that order (both uncommitted in SKILL.md; check-6 graded the second only as an other_violations check, so this is its first verdict here). references/ecto-phoenix.md is unchanged since 0397dec (git diff 0397dec -- idiomatic-elixir/ touches only SKILL.md, references/processes.md and references/testing.md), so the six are graded to the check-6 standard, including its reading of Keep migrations to schema changes: a separate script that uses MyApp.Blog.Post misses the case check, not the rule, which forbids schema modules only inside migrations (haiku-1 line 128 and haiku-2 line 143: alias MyApp.Blog.Post).

Build a multi-line argument under a name before the call changed since check-6: it lost "or holds a call of its own". The sentence that now decides it is "When an argument is a map, struct or keyword list that would span several lines, build it first under a name that says what it is, write it one field per line, and set each multi-line statement apart with a blank line." A one-line keyword or map whose value is a call (the kind that decided check-6's haiku-2: render(conn, :show, post: Blog.get_post!(id))) is now outside it, and so is a one-line map literal the formatter keeps on one line: haiku-1 line 103: |> Log.changeset(%{action: "post.published", resource: "post", resource_id: post.id}) (91 characters) and haiku-2 line 119: attrs = %{action: action, resource: "post", resource_id: post.id, user_id: post.user_id}. Ecto query clauses are treated as check-6 did: a multi-line from/2 counts as clean when the query is named before the Repo call, and an unnamed from(...) piped into Repo is counted under Write pipelines that start with a value, not under this rule.

Every multi-line map/struct/keyword argument, quoted. haiku-1: none; its queries are one-line pipeline steps (lines 69-73, 132-135) and its only map argument is the one-line line 103, so the rule is not exercised. haiku-2: lines 83-88 query = / from(p in Post, / where: ... / order_by: ... / preload: [:user] / ), one clause per line, blank line, line 90: Repo.all(query); lines 146-150 the backfill query named the same way, blank line, line 152: {count, _} = Repo.update_all(query, []): clean. sonnet-1: lines 36-39 the backfill query named, blank line, line 41: {count, nil} = Repo.update_all(query, []); lines 169-173 params = %{ action: ..., user_id: ..., metadata: %{post_id: post.id} }, one field per line, blank line, line 175: %Log{} / line 176: |> Log.changeset(params); lines 123-128 from(p in Post, ...) |> Repo.all() is unnamed and goes to Write pipelines: clean. sonnet-2: lines 64-68 query named, blank line, line 70: Repo.all(query); lines 109-112 attrs = %{ action: ..., description: ... }, blank line, line 114: %Log{}; lines 141-144 backfill query named, blank line, line 146: {count, _} = MyApp.Repo.update_all(query, []): clean.
